headline.purpose: Section headings, led by a 12px lit bead.

label.purpose: Episode numbers, meta, scores; tabular numerals.

shadows.name: bead-edge
shadows.purpose: Bottom bead edge on primary buttons; 2px when pressed. Secondary uses var(--r2), minimal var(--r1).

motion.name: bead-place
motion.purpose: A bead dropping into place (current episode, landing heart).

motion.name: bead-drop
motion.purpose: Loading: five beads dropping onto the peg row.

motion.name: frame-light

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pink block with a deep-pink bead edge; the Play / Continue action.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: DotGothic16, 'MS Gothic', monospace; font-size: 18px; border: 2px solid var(--r0, #0e0814); border-radius: 0; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 100ms; } .ds-btn span { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 4px 24px 6px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #ffb6d5); } .ds-btn-primary span { color: var(--r0, #0e0814); box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 var(--accent-deep, #f78fb8); } .ds-btn-primary:hover span { background: var(--accent-deep, #f78fb8); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active span { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--accent-deep, #f78fb8); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ffb6d5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Raised plum block; Details and other second actions.
components.css: .ds-btn2 { font-family: DotGothic16, 'MS Gothic', monospace; font-size: 18px; background: var(--r3, #2f1f3d); border: 2px solid var(--r0, #0e0814); border-radius: 0; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 100ms; } .ds-btn2 span { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 4px 24px 6px; color: var(--r7, #fbf3ff); box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 var(--r2, #22152d); } .ds-btn2:hover span { background: var(--r4, #463357); } .ds-btn2:active { transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ffb6d5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Disabled Button
components.description: Unavailable: hollow block, label struck through.
components.css: .ds-btn-off { font-family: DotGothic16, 'MS Gothic', monospace; font-size: 16px; min-height: 44px; padding: 4px 16px 6px; background: var(--r1, #170e1f); border: 2px solid var(--r4, #463357); border-radius: 0; color: var(--r5, #9883ab); text-decoration: line-through 2px; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Square search field in the nav with a slash key hint.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: DotGothic16, 'MS Gothic', monospace; font-size: 14px; width: 224px; padding: 10px 14px; background: var(--r1, #170e1f); color: var(--r7, #fbf3ff); border: 1px solid var(--r3, #2f1f3d); border-radius: 0; outline: none; caret-color: var(--accent, #ffb6d5); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--r5, #9883ab); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #ffb6d5); background: var(--r3, #2f1f3d); }

components.name: Nav Bar
components.description: 64px panel bar, wordmark, links with pink active state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--r2, #22152d); border-bottom: 4px solid var(--r0, #0e0814); font-family: DotGothic16, 'MS Gothic', monospace; } .ds-mark { font-size: 26px; margin-right: 24px; } .ds-mark b { font-weight: 400; color: var(--r7, #fbf3ff); } .ds-mark i { font-style: normal; color: var(--accent, #ffb6d5); } .ds-link { position: relative; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--r6, #c9b9d6); cursor: pointer; } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--r7, #fbf3ff); } .ds-on { color: var(--accent, #ffb6d5); background: var(--r3, #2f1f3d); } .ds-on::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: -2px; width: 20px; height: 4px; margin-left: -10px; background: var(--accent, #ffb6d5); }

components.name: Poster Card
components.description: Square plum mat around a 3:4 poster; frame lights dotted pink on hover/focus.
components.html:
Show title

12 eps
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; width: 170px; padding: 6px; background: var(--r2, #22152d); border: 4px solid var(--r0, #0e0814); font-family: DotGothic16, 'MS Gothic', monospace; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.12s steps(2, end); } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:focus-visible { border-style: dotted; border-color: var(--accent, #ffb6d5); outline: none; } .ds-poster { aspect-ratio: 3/4; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--r2, #22152d) 0 8px, var(--r3, #2f1f3d) 8px 16px); } .ds-card-title { margin: 10px 6px 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--r7, #fbf3ff); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-title { color: var(--accent, #ffb6d5); } .ds-card-meta { margin: 4px 6px 6px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--r5, #9883ab); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Spotlight and section container: ink frame, raised hairline.
components.html:
Continue for Jimei

Panel body text.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--r2, #22152d); border: 4px solid var(--r0, #0e0814); font-family: DotGothic16, 'MS Gothic', monospace; } .ds-panel-in { border: 2px solid var(--r3, #2f1f3d); padding: 24px; color: var(--r6, #c9b9d6); } .ds-panel-in h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--r7, #fbf3ff); } .ds-panel-in p { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Bead Strip
components.description: Signature: episodes as beads. Filled = opened on this device, lit = current, hollow = not yet.
components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; background: var(--r1, #170e1f); font-family: DotGothic16, 'MS Gothic', monospace; } .ds-peg { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 6px 4px; background: none; border: 0; font: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--r5, #9883ab); cursor: pointer; } .ds-peg:hover { color: var(--r7, #fbf3ff); } .ds-peg:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ffb6d5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-cur { color: var(--accent, #ffb6d5); } .ds-bead { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--r1, #170e1f) 0 22%, var(--accent, #ffb6d5) 25%); } .ds-hollow { background: radial-gradient(circle, transparent 0 40%, var(--r4, #463357) 43% 68%, transparent 71%); } .ds-peg:hover .ds-hollow { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--r1, #170e1f) 0 22%, var(--accent, #ffb6d5) 25%); } .ds-lit { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--r1, #170e1f), 0 0 0 4px var(--accent, #ffb6d5); }

narrative.overview:
Animei is drawn the way a fan builds a perler-bead sprite for someone: one bead at a time, on a dark plum pegboard. The shell stays plainly a streaming app (top nav, a spotlight, poster grids, a player) and is square, flat and solid. The world enters through four things only: one 8-step plum ramp, one pink bead accent, pixel type everywhere, and the bead itself as the single round object, used as a state marker.

Density is moderate and grid-snapped. Posters are third-party artwork and carry the colour; the UI frames them in square plum mats and never competes. Motion is stepped, like sprite frames, never eased glides. The deliberate rejection is the streaming-clone look: no giant blurred hero banner, no glowing glass cards, no gradient type.

The signature is the bead strip: episodes and chapters as beads on a peg row. It is the episode selector on Watch, the progress mark on the spotlight, the carousel pager, and the loading indicator.
keyCharacteristics: One plum ramp (r0 to r7) for every neutral; no free opacities.
Pink bead as the only accent; deep pink for hover and pressed.
DotGothic16 at weight 400 for all text, smoothing off.
States read without colour: hollow, filled, lit ring, struck through.
Stepped motion (`steps()` timing) for every keyframe.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is one of the eight ramp steps. Tailwind's neutral, stone and indigo scales are remapped onto the ramp and the pink so third-party components land in-world; do not introduce new greys or alpha tints.

rules.name: The Scrim Rule
rules.body: Smooth gradients exist only as an ink (`ramp-0-ink`) to transparent scrim where text or controls sit on artwork: the player control bar and title bar, and poster hover overlays. Beads (radial fill) and the loading stripe are hard-stop gradients and do not count.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Everything is weight 400. Emphasis is size or colour (paper, or pink for a single accent line such as the romaji title).

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Episode numbers, scores, times and counts use tabular numerals so bead rows and meta lines do not jitter.

rules.name: The Ink Frame Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from a 4px ink border, never a shadow or blur.

dos: Do take every neutral from the r0 to r7 ramp and every accent from the pink pair.
Do use the bead as the only round shape, and give each bead a state meaning.
Do make states readable without colour: hollow, filled, lit ring, struck through.
Do frame panels and cards with a 4px ink border and keep corners square.
Do use `steps()` timing for keyframe motion and respect reduced motion.
Do keep mint for airing state and amber/red for warning and error text only.
donts: Don't use drop shadows, blur, glass or glow; depth is tone plus ink borders.
Don't set type in any face but DotGothic16 or in any weight but 400.
Don't use smooth decorative gradients; the only gradients are the ink scrim under text on artwork, the bead's own radial fill, and the hard two-tone loading stripe.
Don't round a corner on anything that is not a bead.
Don't show a disabled control only by dimming it.
